item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Robin S "Shine On" full studio version - from BAPS movie sdtk (1997)
item.description:
Anyone have this rarity? An old LQ clip can be heard in the YouTube link below. But I'm looking for a copy of the FULL studio version with Robin S's vocals (not Kim Mizelle) produced by Tony Moran I think. It was sung in the last scene of the 1997 comedy movie B.A.P.S. but never released on the official soundtrack. Someone's gotta have this in their vault somewhere! Song title is either "Shine On" or I've also seen it as "Your Love Is Shining Down On Me".
